title: Practice: review a tool that an agent proposes (TypeScript)

cases.id: m1 a well formed read only tool is approved and leaves an audit line
cases.says: A well-formed read-only tool is approved and leaves an audit line

cases.id: e1 a description needs at least the minimum number of words
cases.says: A description needs at least the minimum number of words

cases.id: e2 the timeout and the memory may equal their limits and not exceed them
cases.says: The timeout and the memory may equal their limits and not exceed them

cases.id: e3 a name is lower case snake case of at most sixty four characters
cases.says: A name is lower-case snake case of at most 64 characters

cases.id: e4 forbidden calls in the code refuse the tool and are all listed in order
cases.says: Forbidden calls in the code refuse the tool and are all listed in order

cases.id: e5 a permission the code uses without declaring it or a denied one refuses the tool
cases.says: A permission the code uses without declaring it, or a denied one, refuses the tool

cases.id: e6 a declared write is approved only with a gate and a read alone is approved outright
cases.says: A declared write is approved only behind a gate, and a read alone is approved outright

cases.id: e7 a refusal beats a revision and a revision beats a gate
cases.says: A refusal beats a revision and a revision beats a gate

cases.id: e8 the permissions the code uses are reported in alphabetical order
cases.says: The permissions the code uses are reported in alphabetical order
